name: io.github.Servosity/pagerduty-mcp
title: PagerDuty MCP
description: Operate PagerDuty from your AI agent via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the PAGERDUTY_API_KEY credential for the PagerDuty MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the PagerDuty API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every write from the MCP server (read tools only).

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses (reads go to the API).

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on PagerDuty requests.

environmentVariables.name: PAGERDUTY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (at least 32 characters). Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
